cases.description: ImPlot lifetime + known data: a real runtime plugin adopting the host's ImGui/ImPlot contexts plots F-TRAJECTORY time-series, XY, scatter, shaded band, a 3-series legend, a log10 axis, the nonfinite (NaN/Inf skipped) policy and empty series under the themed UI, across 50 in-process reload/reopen cycles per launch (3 fresh launches). Asserts adopted contexts stable + non-null, fitted limits == known ranges, nonfinite samples never move them, log/linear spacing, legend entries, drawn vertices with the series colours at known samples, ImGui stack balance, zero recovered ImGui errors, and a front-buffer pixel probe of the presented image at a known sample.
